name: forest-pup-silhouette
description: Verify actual retained Forest Pup meshes/OWO face plus eight safe authored features, normalized preview/follower geometry parity, native preview eight-corner fit and stable feature identity through twenty follower samples. Aesthetic acceptance requires actual captures. Runs only with settled ownership and ephemeral Studio fixture.

steps.label: wait for player and visual templates

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1]
local world=workspace:WaitForChild('PunchWallRPG')
assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio' and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'refusing non-ephemeral fixture')
assert(game.ServerStorage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'live DataStore opt-in forbids fixture')
assert(p:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and p:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and p:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'profile must be ready ephemeral')
local function ownershipSettled(player)
 local pending=player:GetAttribute('PendingGamePassGrantCount')
 return player:GetAttribute('GamePassOwnershipReconciled')==true
  and player:GetAttribute('GamePassOwnershipReconciliationFailed')==false
  and (pending==nil or pending==0)
end
local ownershipDeadline=os.clock()+20
repeat
 assert(p:GetAttribute('GamePassOwnershipReconciliationFailed')~=true,'GamePass ownership reconciliation failed; fixture not safe')
 if ownershipSettled(p) then break end
 task.wait(.05)
until os.clock()>=ownershipDeadline
assert(ownershipSettled(p),'GamePass ownership not settled before fixture: '..H:JSONEncode({reconciled=p:GetAttribute('GamePassOwnershipReconciled'),failed=p:GetAttribute('GamePassOwnershipReconciliationFailed'),pending=p:GetAttribute('PendingGamePassGrantCount')}))
local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation
assert(c:Invoke('Reset').ok==true,'reset failed')
assert(c:Invoke('GrantPet',{name='Forest Pup',stars=1}).ok==true,'Pup grant failed')
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,seedMode='EphemeralStudio',ownershipSettled=ownershipSettled(p)})

steps.label: seed one Pup after settled ownership in ephemeral Studio
wait for actual equipped Pup replication

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation')
local function awaitValue(fn,message)
 local deadline=os.clock()+8
 repeat local value=fn() if value then return value end task.wait(.05) until os.clock()>=deadline
 error(message)
end
local function verifyPupModel(model)
 assert(model and model:IsA('Model'),'actual Pup model missing')
 assert(model:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName')=='Forest Pup' and model:GetAttribute('SourcePackModelName')=='Dowodle','retained Pup model identity')
 local face,meshes,features=nil,{},{}
 local actualParts=0
 local roles={EarLeft=true,EarRight=true,MuzzleLeft=true,MuzzleRight=true,PawLeft=true,PawRight=true,Collar=true,Tag=true}
 for _,x in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
  if x:IsA('BasePart')then actualParts+=1 end
  if x:IsA('Decal') and x.Face==Enum.NormalId.Front and x.Parent and x.Parent:IsA('BasePart') and x.Parent.Name=='AnimatedFace' then
   assert(not face and x.Texture=='rbxassetid://2759037468' and x.Transparency==0,'actual retained face decal changed') face=x
  end
  if x:IsA('MeshPart')then
   assert((x.MeshId=='rbxassetid://1461040253' or x.MeshId=='rbxassetid://1461041563') and not meshes[x.MeshId],'retained mesh identity changed or duplicated') meshes[x.MeshId]=x
  end
  local role=x:GetAttribute('ForestPupFeature')
  if role then
   assert(roles[role] and not features[role],'invalid or duplicate Pup role')
   assert(x:IsA('Part') and x.Shape==Enum.PartType.Ball and x.Material==Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,'Pup features must be matte native geometry')
   assert(x.Anchored and not x.CanCollide and not x.CanTouch and not x.CanQuery and #x:GetDescendants()==0,'Pup feature physics/effects/joints unsafe')
   features[role]=x
  end
 end
 assert(actualParts==12,'actual total model parts must be four retained plus eight authored')
 assert(face and meshes['rbxassetid://1461040253'] and meshes['rbxassetid://1461041563'],'original face and both meshes required')
 local facePart=face.Parent
 assert(facePart.Transparency==1,'retained transparent face carrier became opaque')
 local count,rows=0,{}
 local size=facePart.Size
 for role in pairs(roles)do
  local x=assert(features[role],'actual feature missing '..role) count+=1
  local localPosition=facePart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(x.Position)
  local look=facePart.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(x.CFrame.LookVector)
  assert(x.Size.X>0 and x.Size.Y>0 and x.Size.Z>0 and x.Size.X<=size.X*.87 and x.Size.Y<=size.Y*.59 and x.Size.Z<=size.Z*.31,'unbounded Pup feature size')
  local minX,minY,minZ=math.huge,math.huge,math.huge
  local maxX,maxY=-math.huge,-math.huge
  for sx=-1,1,2 do for sy=-1,1,2 do for sz=-1,1,2 do
   local q=facePart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(x.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(x.Size.X*sx,x.Size.Y*sy,x.Size.Z*sz)*.5))
   minX,minY,minZ=math.min(minX,q.X),math.min(minY,q.Y),math.min(minZ,q.Z)
   maxX,maxY=math.max(maxX,q.X),math.max(maxY,q.Y)
  end end end
  assert(not(minX<size.X*.38 and maxX>-size.X*.38 and minY<size.Y*.30 and maxY>-size.Y*.23 and minZ<=-size.Z*.5),'Pup feature covers central OWO face zone')
  if role:find('Ear',1,true)then assert(math.abs(localPosition.X)>=size.X*.59 and (minX<-size.X*.5 or maxX>size.X*.5),'ears do not extend silhouette')end
  if role:find('Muzzle',1,true)then assert(localPosition.Z<-size.Z*.5 and maxY<-size.Y*.23,'muzzle is not below the front face')end
  if role:find('Paw',1,true)then assert(minY<-size.Y*.72,'paws do not extend below body')end
  rows[role]={size={x.Size.X/size.X,x.Size.Y/size.Y,x.Size.Z/size.Z},position={localPosition.X/size.X,localPosition.Y/size.Y,localPosition.Z/size.Z},look={look.X,look.Y,look.Z},color={x.Color.R,x.Color.G,x.Color.B}}
 end
 assert(count==8 and count<=9 and model:GetAttribute('ForestPupSilhouetteVersion')=='AuthoredPupV1' and model:GetAttribute('ForestPupSilhouettePartCount')==count,'actual Pup feature budget/version mismatch')
 local meshRows={}
 for uri,x in pairs(meshes)do meshRows[uri]={x.Size.X/size.X,x.Size.Y/size.Y,x.Size.Z/size.Z} end
 return {features=rows,meshSizes=meshRows,count=count,face=face.Texture},features
end
local function sameGeometry(expected,actual)
 assert(expected.count==actual.count and expected.face==actual.face,'preview/follower identity mismatch')
 for role,row in pairs(expected.features)do
  for key,values in pairs(row)do for index,value in ipairs(values)do assert(math.abs(value-actual.features[role][key][index])<.004,'preview/follower normalized geometry mismatch '..role..' '..key)end end
 end
 for uri,values in pairs(expected.meshSizes)do for index,value in ipairs(values)do assert(math.abs(value-actual.meshSizes[uri][index])<.004,'retained mesh normalized size mismatch '..uri)end end
end
local function verifyPreview(viewport,model)
 assert(viewport and viewport.Visible and viewport.CurrentCamera,'native preview unavailable')
 local camera=viewport.CurrentCamera
 local face
 for _,x in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do if x:IsA('Decal') and x.Texture=='rbxassetid://2759037468'then face=x.Parent break end end
 assert(face,'preview face missing')
 local plane=face.CFrame.Position+face.CFrame.LookVector*face.Size.Z*.5
 local signed=face.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(camera.CFrame.Position-plane)
 assert(signed>.05,'preview camera behind authored face')
 local cf,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
 local width,height=viewport.AbsoluteSize.X,viewport.AbsoluteSize.Y
 assert(width>0 and height>0,'preview dimensions missing')
 local tanV=math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView*.5))
 local maximum=0
 for x=-1,1,2 do for y=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
  local q=camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(size.X*x,size.Y*y,size.Z*z)*.5))
  local depth=-q.Z
  local nx,ny=math.abs(q.X)/(depth*tanV*width/height),math.abs(q.Y)/(depth*tanV)
  assert(depth>.05 and nx<=1/1.12+.001 and ny<=1/1.12+.001,'new Pup silhouette clipped in native preview')
  maximum=math.max(maximum,nx,ny)
 end end end
 return {width=width,height=height,faceDot=signed,maxNdc=maximum}
end
local before=a:Invoke('Snapshot')
local setting=a:Invoke('SetSettings',{motion=true,persist=false})
assert(setting.motion==true and a:Invoke('Snapshot').motion==true,'actual motion setting did not apply')
local proof={}
local ok,result=pcall(function()
 local world=awaitValue(function()
  local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild(player.Name..' Client Companions')
  if folder then for _,x in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do if x:IsA('Model') and x:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName')=='Forest Pup' then return x end end end
 end,'actual equipped Pup did not appear')
 local worldState,worldParts=verifyPupModel(world)
 a:Invoke('OpenInventory') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Pets') a:Invoke('SetInventoryRarity','All') a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','')
 local r=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory
 local body=r.InventoryWindow.InventoryBody
 local card=awaitValue(function()
  for _,x in ipairs(body.InventoryGridPane.InventoryGrid:GetChildren())do
   local v=x:FindFirstChild('ItemPetPreview',true)
   if x:IsA('GuiObject') and x.Visible and v and v:GetAttribute('PreviewPetName')=='Forest Pup' then return x end
  end
 end,'actual Pup card did not appear')
 task.wait(.3)
 local cv=card:FindFirstChild('ItemPetPreview',true)
 local cardWorld=cv:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('WorldModel')
 local cardModel=cardWorld and cardWorld:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model')
 local cardState=verifyPupModel(cardModel)
 sameGeometry(worldState,cardState)
 proof.card=verifyPreview(cv,cardModel)
 local key=card:GetAttribute('InventoryKey')
 a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem',key) task.wait(.3)
 local dv=body.InventoryDetail:FindFirstChild('DetailPetPreview',true)
 local detailWorld=dv and dv:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('WorldModel')
 local detailModel=detailWorld and detailWorld:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model')
 local detailState=verifyPupModel(detailModel)
 sameGeometry(worldState,detailState)
 proof.detail=verifyPreview(dv,detailModel)
 a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem',key) task.wait(.15)
 assert(cardModel.Parent==cardWorld and detailModel.Parent==detailWorld,'selection rebuilt actual previews')
 a:Invoke('CloseInventory')
 local firstPivot=world:GetPivot().Position
 local maximumMotion=0
 for index=1,20 do
  task.wait(.1)
  assert(world.Parent and worldParts.EarLeft.Parent==world and worldParts.Tag.Parent==world,'actual follower/features replaced during normal updates')
  local current,parts=verifyPupModel(world)
  sameGeometry(worldState,current)
  assert(parts.EarLeft==worldParts.EarLeft and parts.Tag==worldParts.Tag,'actual feature instances changed')
  maximumMotion=math.max(maximumMotion,(world:GetPivot().Position-firstPivot).Magnitude)
 end
 proof.world={count=worldState.count,samples=20,observedMotion=maximumMotion,source=world:GetAttribute('VisualSource'),scale=world:GetScale()}
 return {ok=true,proof=proof,geometryParity=true,aestheticApproval=false}
end)
a:Invoke('CloseInventory')
local restored=a:Invoke('SetSettings',{motion=before.motion,persist=false})
assert(restored.motion==before.motion and a:Invoke('Snapshot').motion==before.motion,'failed to restore actual motion setting')
assert(ok,'Forest Pup actual silhouette failed: '..tostring(result)..' '..H:JSONEncode(proof))
return H:JSONEncode(result)
